assets.identity_finding: Kraken publishes the asset as Sport.fun on Base. Independently, the project's own documentation at docs.sport.fun publishes an 'Official contract addresses' table giving Chain = Base and Address = 0x16EE7ecAc70d1028E7712751E2Ee6BA808a7dd92 for $FUN, its whitepaper states the blockchain layer operates on Base, and its tokenomics page describes $FUN as an ERC-20 with a 1,000,000,000 fixed supply issued by Sport.fun. Both organisations therefore agree on ticker, chain and project. TICKER-COLLISION NOTE: the FUN ticker was historically used by the unrelated FunFair ERC-20 on Ethereum Mainnet; that project was deliberately not used as a source, and this record binds only the Sport.fun Base contract that matches Kraken's published name and network.

Kraken publishes the asset as Hivemapper on Solana. Independently, the Hivemapper Foundation's own page states HONEY tokens are a cryptocurrency built on the Solana blockchain with the first HONEY minted on 2022-11-01 and a fixed maximum supply of 10 billion, and links the mint's own transaction history at the SPL mint 4vMsoUT2BWatFweudnQM1xedRLfJgJ7hswhcpz4xgBTy; the project's own documentation at docs.hivemapper.com independently describes the same Solana HONEY token. Both organisations agree on ticker, chain and project, and the record binds the published mint.

Kraken publishes the asset as RedStone on Ethereum (ERC-20). Independently, RedStone's own documentation at docs.redstone.finance publishes a contract table with Network = Ethereum and Address = 0xc43c6bfeda065fe2c4c11765bf838789bd0bb5de, its distribution page states RED is implemented as an ERC-20 token on Ethereum Mainnet, and the project's own tokenomics announcement on blog.redstone.finance gives Token Standard ERC-20 on the Ethereum network. Both organisations agree on ticker, chain and token standard, and the record binds the published contract.

Kraken publishes the asset as Thorchain with the network THORchain, i.e. the project's own chain. Independently, THORChain's own technical documentation states that THORChain's native token is called RUNE, that RUNE is the settlement asset for all liquidity pools and the bonded security asset for nodes, and its introductory page describes RUNE as the native utility token of THORChain. Both organisations agree on ticker, chain and project. This is a native-coin identity on the project's own layer-1, the same source shape as the ratified ETC and VET native-coin records, so there is no contract address to bind and none is claimed.

Kraken publishes the asset as Siacoin with the network Siacoin, i.e. the project's own chain. Independently, the Sia project's own site states that siacoins are the primary currency of the Sia network and defines one siacoin as 10^24 of the chain's base unit, and its own documentation independently describes siacoins as the currency of the Sia proof-of-work blockchain used to pay for storage contracts. Both organisations agree on ticker, chain and project. This is a native-coin identity on the project's own layer-1, the same source shape as the ratified ETC and VET native-coin records, so there is no contract address to bind and none is claimed.

scope: Source-coverage universe identity only: not investability, not capacity, not venue selection, not candidate promotion, not Regime activation, not Production wiring, not trading authority.
verification_bar: Two independent official sources per asset: the retained Kraken catalog (enabled asset with exactly one online <ASSET>/USD pair) plus Kraken's published asset name and network, matched independently against a project/foundation protocol document, token contract publication, migration notice or exact-contract asset report. Ticker text alone was not accepted. Kraken's own metadata carries no chain, contract or genesis field, so Kraken alone never satisfies the bar. Where the project publishes an exact contract or mint the record binds that identifier; where it publishes only the chain and token standard the record says so explicitly and claims no contract. Where two independent official sources could not be obtained, the asset is recorded as unverified_identity with its evidence, or left unclassified where there is no evidence either way.
